privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.intro: This policy explains what data MyNkap collects, why, and how it is protected and used.
privacy_page.s1_body: MyNkap is a personal finance tracking and planning application for the Central African market (CEMAC zone), published under the trade name "MyNkap" (see our Legal Notice for the publisher's full identity). For any question about your personal data, contact us at support@mynkap.com.
privacy_page.s2_body: When you create an account, we collect your first and last name, email address, phone number and a password, stored hashed and never in plain text. If you sign in with Google, we receive your email, first name and last name from your Google account. The financial data you enter yourself in the app (accounts, transactions, budgets, debts, savings goals, tontines) is self-declared: MyNkap does not access any real bank or Mobile Money account and cannot view or modify your actual balances. We also keep limited technical data (IP address, login logs) for security purposes.
privacy_page.s3_body: Your data is used to create and secure your account, let you use budget-tracking features and the JARVIS assistant, send you the emails required for the service to work (email verification at sign-up, password reset, security notifications), process your paid subscriptions, and keep the app secure and reliable.
privacy_page.s4_title: 4. Who we share your data with
privacy_page.s4_body: We never sell your data. It is shared only with the technical providers needed to run the service: Brevo (transactional emails), Google (if you choose to sign in with Google), HR-Skills Pay (Mobile Money payment processing for paid subscriptions), and our application/database hosting provider. These providers only use your data to deliver the requested service.
privacy_page.s5_body: Your data is kept for as long as your account stays active. If you request account deletion, your personal data is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable time, subject to retention periods required by law, notably for billing/accounting records.
privacy_page.s6_body: Passwords are hashed, session tokens are hashed in the database, and communications use HTTPS. Account creation is protected by a verification code sent by email. No system is foolproof, so we recommend using a unique password and reporting any suspicious activity to us immediately.
privacy_page.s7_body: MyNkap does not use advertising cookies or third-party analytics/tracking tools. Your session is kept in your browser's local storage (localStorage) solely to keep you signed in: this data stays on your device and is never shared for tracking purposes.
privacy_page.s8_body: You can request access, correction, export or deletion of your personal data at any time by writing to support@mynkap.com or via WhatsApp at +237 677 246 900. These requests are handled manually by our team within a reasonable time, after verifying your identity.
privacy_page.s9_body: Some of our providers (email delivery, Google authentication) may process data outside your country of residence. We only work with providers that apply appropriate security safeguards.
privacy_page.s10_body: MyNkap is not intended for people under 18. If you believe a minor has shared personal data with us, please contact us so we can delete it.
privacy_page.s11_body: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the service or to regulations. The last-updated date appears at the top of this page. For significant changes, we will notify you by email or within the app.
privacy_page.s12_body: For any question about this policy or your personal data: support@mynkap.com or +237 677 246 900 (WhatsApp).

terms_page.title: Terms of Service
terms_page.intro: These Terms of Service govern access to and use of the MyNkap application. By creating an account, you accept them without reservation.
terms_page.s1_body: These Terms of Service define the rules for accessing and using MyNkap, a personal finance tracking and planning application.
terms_page.s2_body: MyNkap is a tracking, categorization and financial planning tool: you enter your own accounts, transactions, budgets, debts, savings goals and tontines. MyNkap is not a bank, an electronic money institution, or a payment service provider: the app does not hold, transfer or move any real funds. All financial data displayed is self-declared and reflects the information entered by the user; MyNkap has no access to your real bank or Mobile Money accounts and cannot guarantee the accuracy of displayed balances if entries are not kept up to date.
terms_page.s3_body: To use MyNkap, you must create an account with a valid email address and confirm it via the verification code sent by email. You agree to provide accurate information and to keep your password confidential. You are responsible for all activity carried out from your account.
terms_page.s4_body: You agree to use MyNkap only for personal, lawful purposes, not to attempt to bypass security measures, not to disrupt the service, and not to use it for fraudulent purposes. Any account used in violation of these rules may be suspended or deleted.
terms_page.s5_body: MyNkap offers a free plan as well as paid plans (ESSENTIEL, PREMIUM) unlocking additional features, billed in CFA Francs (XAF) via Mobile Money. Pricing, billing, renewal and refund terms are detailed in our Terms of Sale.
terms_page.s6_body: Suggestions and analyses generated by the JARVIS assistant and the financial analysis modules are provided for informational and educational purposes only. They do not constitute professional financial, tax or legal advice and do not make MyNkap liable for your financial decisions.
terms_page.s7_body: The MyNkap application, its brand, logo, interface and content are protected by intellectual property law. You retain full ownership of the data you enter; you only grant us the right to process it to provide you with the service.
terms_page.s8_body: We strive to provide a reliable, available service, without guaranteeing uninterrupted availability. Temporary interruptions may occur for maintenance or technical changes. We may change, modify or remove certain features, informing you when reasonably possible.
terms_page.s9_body: You may stop using MyNkap at any time and request deletion of your account by contacting support@mynkap.com. We may suspend or terminate an account in case of violation of these Terms, with notice where circumstances allow.
terms_page.s10_body: MyNkap is a personal financial management aid provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, MyNkap shall not be liable for financial decisions made based on information displayed in the app, nor for the consequences of incomplete or incorrect data entry by the user.
terms_page.s11_body: These Terms are governed by the laws in force in the Republic of Cameroon and, where applicable, the relevant OHADA uniform acts. Any dispute relating to their interpretation or execution falls, failing an amicable resolution, under the jurisdiction of Cameroonian courts.
terms_page.s12_body: We may amend these Terms to reflect changes to the service, the law, or regulations. Continued use of MyNkap after an update constitutes acceptance of the amended Terms.
terms_page.s13_body: For any question about these Terms: support@mynkap.com or +237 677 246 900 (WhatsApp).

terms_of_sale_page.title: Terms of Sale
terms_of_sale_page.intro: These Terms of Sale apply to any purchase of a paid MyNkap subscription and supplement our Terms of Service.
terms_of_sale_page.s1_body: These Terms of Sale govern the subscription and payment of MyNkap paid plans (ESSENTIEL and PREMIUM).
terms_of_sale_page.s2_body: MyNkap offers a FREE plan as well as two paid plans, ESSENTIEL and PREMIUM, unlocking additional features (debt tracking, savings, recurring transactions, tontines, advanced financial analysis, JARVIS assistant depending on the plan). Prices, shown in CFA Francs (XAF), are displayed in the app before any subscription and can be billed monthly or annually.
terms_of_sale_page.s3_body: Every new account gets a 30-day free trial giving access to all features. At the end of this period, the account automatically reverts to the FREE plan unless a paid plan is subscribed.
terms_of_sale_page.s4_body: Payments for paid subscriptions are processed via Mobile Money through our payment provider, HR-Skills Pay. MyNkap does not store any payment information (Mobile Money number, PIN code): this is processed directly by the payment provider.
terms_of_sale_page.s5_body: Depending on the option chosen, your subscription may renew automatically at the due date (monthly or annual) at the then-current rate. You can disable automatic renewal at any time from your account, before the due date.
terms_of_sale_page.s6_body: If payment fails or is not renewed at the due date, your account automatically reverts to the FREE plan: data already entered remains stored, but access to paid features is suspended until a new subscription is made.
terms_of_sale_page.s7_body: As this is a digital service whose performance begins upon subscription, the right of withdrawal may not apply once the subscription is activated, in accordance with applicable regulations. For any billing issue or refund request, contact support@mynkap.com: each situation is reviewed individually.
terms_of_sale_page.s8_body: You may cancel your paid subscription at any time from your account or by contacting support@mynkap.com. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the already-paid period; no pro-rata refund is issued unless required by law.
terms_of_sale_page.s9_body: We may change our pricing. Any change is communicated before it applies and does not apply retroactively to a subscription already paid for the current period.
terms_of_sale_page.s10_body: For any question about your subscription or billing: support@mynkap.com or +237 677 246 900 (WhatsApp).

hero.subtitle: MyNkap is the smart app built specifically for the Central African market. Bring your Orange Money, MTN MoMo, bank and cash accounts together in one place, with the help of our AI-powered financial assistant.

ia.description: Our AI assistant isn't just a chatbot. It's directly connected to your recorded financial flows. It learns your spending habits to offer personalized savings advice, anticipate overdrafts, and automate entry through voice commands.
ia.point4: Automatic detection of duplicates or suspicious transactions
ia.demo_question: Can I afford to buy a phone for 250,000 XAF this month?
ia.demo_answer: Based on your income (800,000 XAF) and your current fixed expenses (300,000 XAF), yes you can. However, this will reduce your 'Douala Land' savings goal by 12% this month. I recommend waiting until the 5th of next month.
ia.demo_placeholder: Ask the AI a financial question...

features.description: No more clutter from statements spread across multiple phones or banks. With MyNkap, you get a main aggregator account that automatically adds up your entire gross net worth in real time.
features.mobile_money_desc: MTN MoMo and Orange Money built in to track your transfers and top-ups instantly.
features.savings_desc: Every savings goal gets its own dedicated savings account, created automatically.

tontines.title_part2: finally organized, without ever touching your money
tontines.description: MyNkap never holds the money for your tontine or njangi — the money keeps moving between you, just like always. The app simply takes care of what's tedious to track by hand: who has paid in, whose turn it is, and when.
tontines.point1: Round rotation generated automatically based on member order
tontines.point2: Tracking of contributions paid, round by round
tontines.point4: Full history kept, even after a round is closed

rigor.title: Strict Accounting & Financial Rigor
rigor.subtitle: MyNkap is built on modern accounting principles to guarantee flawless traceability and a faithful picture of your gross and net financial position.
rigor.immutability_desc: A recorded transaction can never be deleted directly. All corrections happen through a reversing transaction, ensuring an unalterable audit trail.
rigor.networth_desc: Net worth is calculated dynamically: sum of active balances minus the sum of your debts plus the sum of your claims.
rigor.atomic_desc: No balance gap is tolerated. Every financial operation (transfer, wire, purchase) runs atomically as a SQL transaction.
